title: Strip opencv-python-headless to eliminate FFmpeg ObjC class collision
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-13)
plan_section: V2-016 issue (6) — was TBD; this PRD resolves it
trigger: Operator 2026-09-13 (verbatim): 'we had FFMPG contention issues yesterday because we were using two different versions in the same VENv. Did that get resolved? That appeared as a camera issue.' Confirmed: PyAV (av) bundles libavformat.62, OpenCV (cv2) bundles libavformat.60. Both load into the same Python process during one alert path (listener/daemon → infra.gate → infra.frame_capture + infra.frame_diff + infra.quick_classifier). On macOS, two FFmpeg builds loaded into one process trigger an Objective-C runtime class-name collision (av/.dylibs/libavdevice.62 vs cv2/.dylibs/libavdevice.61), corrupting the PyAV binding. Symptom: SIGSEGV in libavformat.62.12.102.dylib at NULL struct-member offset 0x20, faultingThread=8 inside PyAV's container.demux(). v1-refactor avoids this by isolating PyAV and cv2 into separate runtime trees. v2 broke that pattern. Fix: strip cv2 from runtime and replace its 4 use-sites with numpy/PIL.
background: V2-016 PRD item (6) flagged the FFmpeg/ObjC collision as TBD pending 'post-fix logging to confirm'. Today's SIGSEGV crash-loop in daemon (4 crashes in 90s, exit code -11, ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/python3.11-*.ips) is the post-fix confirmation. v1-refactor's pattern (cv2 isolated from PyAV's import chain) is the working reference. PRD's design choice: STRIP cv2 entirely (don't isolate via subprocess), because the cv2 surface in v2 is small (4 files, ~10 cv2 calls total) and PIL+numpy replacements are straightforward.

operator_guarantees.git_maintained: Every story lands its work as a real git commit on main BEFORE claiming done. Worker reports 'done' without a commit SHA on main = card failed. Reviewer verifies via `git log main --grep <story_id>`. Working-tree edits that aren't committed are silently lost on worktree reap.
operator_guarantees.code_actually_written: Every AC is a re-runnable shell command with explicit expected output. Reviewer's round-2 lens: checkout the work, run every AC verbatim, compare actual to expected. No 'looks right'. No diff-summary-only approval. If a test exists for the file, run it. If `python -c '...'` is in the AC, run it.
operator_guarantees.no_fallback_no_residue: After every story lands, the file must NOT contain: (a) cv2 imports, (b) cv2 calls, (c) `try: import cv2` fallback paths, (d) any `if cv2_available:` / `# in case cv2` / `# backup` style comments. Reviewer's round-3 lens: `git grep` for residual patterns across the runtime tree. The strip is binary: cv2 is gone from runtime, not 'available optionally'.

shipping_definition: (a) opencv-python-headless removed from pyproject.toml. (b) All cv2 imports removed from runtime modules. (c) All cv2 function calls replaced with numpy/PIL equivalents. (d) After strip, ls .venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/cv2/ → directory does not exist. (e) Daemon stays unloaded. (f) All 313 existing tests still pass. (g) New unit tests cover the numpy/PIL replacements. (h) NO try/except ImportError cv2 fallback paths. NO optional cv2 use. (i) Every story has a commit on main with <story_id> in the message.
scope_exclusions: Do NOT touch /Users/jill/farm-surveillance/ (v1). OFF and stays OFF.
Do NOT git push to forgejo or GitHub. Operator reviews and pushes.
Do NOT install new skills. Use existing skill set.
Do NOT replace PIL with anything else — keep PIL as the PIL backend.
Do NOT migrate v1-refactor code; only v2 runtime.
Do NOT add a try/except ImportError fallback to cv2 anywhere. Strip means gone.
Do NOT add feature flags like HAS_CV2 or CV2_OPTIONAL. Strip means gone.
Do NOT restart the daemon in this PRD. Daemon stays unloaded until post-PRD verification.
design_principles: Single-file scope per story. Each story modifies exactly one runtime file + its companion test.
Numpy/PIL replacements use functions already imported elsewhere in the codebase — no new deps.
Numerical equivalence: numpy/PIL output must match cv2 output for known test inputs.
No subprocess isolation, no dlopen-order tricks — strip the dep entirely.
Every story = single commit on main, message includes <story_id>, working tree clean.
Residual pattern ACs run on EVERY story — no card flips to done with cv2 residue on main.
